d:
A love that shines brighter than the stars Taare is Diljit Dosanjh’s romantic song from the superhit film Sardaarji, with lyrics by Veet Baljit and music by Nick Dhammu, now presented with a brand-new video.
Diljit’s soulful voice and the song’s dreamy melody make Taare one of the most loved songs from Sardaarji, perfect for every love story under the night sky
White Hill Productions Presents
"SARDAARJI"
In Association with Dalmora Entertainment
A Film by Rohit Jugraj
Song : Taare
Singer : Diljit Dosanjh
